boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Florida Gulf Coast University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food runs around FGCU and greater Fort Myers, each backed by current late-night hours from an official location page. Confirm hours before leaving campus because holiday schedules may vary.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell — 17460 Ben Hill Griffin Parkway
cards.title: The Closest 4 A.M. Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: Ben Hill Griffin Parkway, beside the FGCU area
cards.notes: Check the drive-thru schedule, then use the campus-side Ben Hill Griffin Parkway location for a very late pickup.
cards.short_summary: A campus-adjacent drive-thru operating into the early morning every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists this Fort Myers location at 17460 Ben Hill Griffin Parkway and shows drive-thru service until 4:00 a.m. or 5:00 a.m., depending on the day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Fort Myers, FL — 17460 Ben Hill Griffin Parkway
cards.access_notes: Official hours show the drive-thru open until 4:00 a.m. Monday-Wednesday and Sunday, and 5:00 a.m. Thursday-Saturday; dine-in hours are shorter.

cards.title: The All-Night Constitution Boulevard Stop
cards.subtitle: Constitution Boulevard near Daniels Parkway
cards.notes: Use this option when timing is uncertain; verify the locator before departure and choose lobby or drive-thru service.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock restaurant and drive-thru southeast of central Fort Myers.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's lists its 7105 Constitution Boulevard restaurant and drive-thru as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: McDonald's at 7105 Constitution Blvd, Fort Myers, FL
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists both restaurant/lobby and drive-thru service as open 24 hours every day.

cards.title: A 24-Hour Booth on Marketplace Road
cards.subtitle: Marketplace Road near Daniels Parkway
cards.notes: Choose this diner when the group wants seated service; review the menu online and confirm holiday timing before driving.
cards.short_summary: An all-hours diner with walk-in seating, takeout, and meals beyond breakfast.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's identifies the restaurant at 9340 Marketplace Road as open 24 hours daily and lists walk-ins, groups, kids, and takeout among its services.
cards.access_notes: The official locator marks this restaurant open 24 hours throughout the week; Denny's advises contacting the location to confirm holiday hours.

cards.title: The Daniels Parkway Midnight Window
cards.subtitle: Daniels Parkway east of I-75
cards.notes: Check the day before heading out: this restaurant reaches 1 a.m. most nights, while Sunday closes at midnight.
cards.short_summary: A late drive-thru with predictable weekday and Saturday closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours at 9301 Daniels Parkway through 1:00 a.m. Monday-Saturday and midnight Sunday.
cards.source_title: Wendy's Daniels Pkwy in Fort Myers, FL
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru remain open until 1:00 a.m. Monday-Saturday and midnight Sunday, according to the official page.

cards.title: The Anytime Pancake Table
cards.subtitle: South Cleveland Avenue at the College Parkway area
cards.notes: Make this the sit-down choice for a longer run; the official page lists dine-in, takeout, ordering, and 24-hour service.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour table-service option serving breakfast and other meals at any hour.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP lists its 12801 South Cleveland Avenue restaurant as open 24 hours every day, with dine-in, online ordering, takeout, and late-night food.
cards.source_title: IHOP at 12801 S Cleveland Avenue, Fort Myers
cards.access_notes: The official restaurant page shows 24-hour opening Monday-Sunday and identifies dine-in and late-night food as available amenities.

cards.title: The South Tamiami Wing Run
cards.subtitle: South Tamiami Trail north of San Carlos Park
cards.notes: Use the official order page to confirm the closing time and submit the order before making the northbound pickup run.
cards.short_summary: A late carryout destination on the corridor between FGCU and Fort Myers.
cards.evidence_claim: Wingstop's official Fort Myers directory identifies a restaurant at 18911 South Tamiami Trail, Suite 6, as a current orderable location.
cards.access_notes: The official directory provides live open/closed status for this location; check it immediately before departure because the page does not expose a stable weekly table.

cards.title: Pizza Through 1 A.M. on Weekends
cards.subtitle: South Tamiami Trail near San Carlos Park
cards.notes: Place the order before leaving campus; carryout and delivery end at midnight most nights and 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A south-corridor pizza counter with late carryout and delivery hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns lists delivery and carryout at 18990 South Tamiami Trail until midnight Sunday-Thursday and 1:00 a.m. Friday-Saturday.
cards.source_title: Papa Johns S. Tamiami Trail, Fort Myers, FL
cards.access_notes: Carryout and delivery run until midnight Monday-Thursday and Sunday, and until 1:00 a.m. Friday-Saturday.

cards.title: Wings at the Midnight Mark
cards.subtitle: South Cleveland Avenue in Fort Myers
cards.notes: Order online before the drive; this branch offers carryout to midnight nightly and an extra hour Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A carryout-focused stop with midnight-or-later service throughout the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Wingstop lists carryout and delivery at 12011 South Cleveland Avenue through midnight Sunday-Thursday and 1:00 a.m. Friday-Saturday.
cards.source_title: Wingstop Fort Myers — 12011 S Cleveland Ave
cards.access_notes: Official carryout and delivery hours end at midnight Sunday-Thursday and 1:00 a.m. Friday-Saturday.

cards.title: The Fiddlesticks Boulevard Pizza Pickup
cards.subtitle: Fiddlesticks Boulevard near I-75
cards.notes: Submit the order before the posted cutoff; the location supports both carryout and delivery through midnight or later.
cards.short_summary: A late pizza option positioned east of the interstate on a campus-to-city route.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns lists delivery and carryout at 13650 Fiddlesticks Boulevard until midnight Sunday-Thursday and 1:00 a.m. Friday-Saturday.
cards.source_title: Papa Johns Fiddlesticks Blvd, Fort Myers, FL
cards.access_notes: The official page shows carryout and delivery until midnight Sunday-Thursday and 1:00 a.m. Friday-Saturday.

cards.title: The 24-Hour South Tamiami Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: South Tamiami Trail in Fort Myers
cards.notes: Plan on drive-thru service after 11 p.m.; the dining room closes earlier even though the vehicle lane operates all night.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock drive-thru with a separately timed dining room.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's lists the drive-thru at 14985 South Tamiami Trail as open 24 hours daily, while restaurant and lobby hours end at 11:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: McDonald's at 14985 S Tamiami Trail, Fort Myers
cards.access_notes: The official page lists the drive-thru as open 24 hours every day; restaurant and lobby service is listed only through 11:00 p.m.

warnings: Wingstop's Fort Myers directory confirms the 18911 South Tamiami Trail destination and provides live status, but it does not expose a stable weekly hours table; check the direct page immediately before travel.
Late-night access varies by service channel at Taco Bell and the South Tamiami Trail McDonald's; their dining rooms close before their drive-thrus.
Several destinations are farther from campus than the Ben Hill Griffin Parkway stop; this board covers the broader FGCU–Fort Myers area rather than claiming every location is adjacent to campus.
